_comment: Pelican egg — s&box native Linux dedicated server. Replace author email before publishing.
name: s&box
author: hello@example.com
description: Native Linux s&box dedicated server via SteamCMD (App ID 1892930). Install forces Linux depots with `+@sSteamCmdForcePlatformType linux`; if you still see `Missing configuration` or `No subscription`, set Beta Branch to `staging`, use SteamCMD login variables with an account that owns s&box, or refresh SteamCMD. Runtime: use a dotnet yolk (default ghcr.io/pelican-eggs/yolks:dotnet_10) and start with `dotnet sbox-server.dll` — the shipped `sbox-server.exe` is a Windows PE and will fail with Exec format error if invoked directly on Linux. Startup exports LD_LIBRARY_PATH to `bin/linuxsteamrt64` so `libengine2.so` resolves. If you still get NativeAssemblyLoadException for `libengine2.so`, run `ldd bin/linuxsteamrt64/libengine2.so` in the container: missing GLIBC_2.38 / GLIBCXX means the stock Bookworm-based yolk is too old — switch the nest to a custom image with Ubuntu 24.04+ or Debian 13+ plus .NET 10, or use a Wine-based community egg (e.g. HyberHost gameforge-sbox-egg). Facepunch docs: https://sbox.game/dev/doc/networking/dedicated-servers/
startup: SBOX_HOME="/home/container/steamapps/common/sbox dedicated server"; [ -f "$SBOX_HOME/sbox-server.dll" ] || [ -f "$SBOX_HOME/sbox-server.exe" ] || SBOX_HOME="/home/container"; cd "$SBOX_HOME" && export LD_LIBRARY_PATH="$SBOX_HOME/bin/linuxsteamrt64:$SBOX_HOME:${LD_LIBRARY_PATH:-}" && exec dotnet sbox-server.dll +game {{GAME_IDENT}} {{MAP_IDENT}} +hostname "{{SERVER_NAME}}" +port {{SERVER_PORT}} +net_query_port {{QUERY_PORT}} +net_game_server_token {{STEAM_GAME_SERVER_TOKEN}} {{SBOX_PROJECT}} {{EXTRA_ARGS}}

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# s&box dedicated server — SteamCMD install (Pelican). Server root: /mnt/server
set -euo pipefail

# Anonymous login unless BOTH STEAM_USER and STEAM_PASS are set.
if [[ -n "${STEAM_USER:-}" && "${STEAM_USER,,}" != "anonymous" ]]; then
  if [[ -z "${STEAM_PASS:-}" ]]; then
    echo "Error: SteamCMD Login Username is set but password is empty. Fill SteamCMD Login Password or clear the username for anonymous."
    exit 1
  fi
  echo "Using Steam account login for SteamCMD."
else
  echo "Using anonymous Steam login."
  STEAM_USER=anonymous
  STEAM_PASS=""
  STEAM_AUTH=""
fi

cd /tmp
mkdir -p /mnt/server/steamcmd
curl -sSL -o /tmp/steamcmd.tar.gz https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz
tar -xzf /tmp/steamcmd.tar.gz -C /mnt/server/steamcmd
mkdir -p /mnt/server/steamapps
cd /mnt/server/steamcmd
chown -R root:root /mnt 2>/dev/null || true
export HOME=/mnt/server

STEAM_APPID="${STEAM_APPID:-1892930}"

# Without this, multi-OS apps can fail with: ERROR! Failed to install app (Missing configuration)
echo "SteamCMD: forcing Linux depots (@sSteamCmdForcePlatformType linux) for app ${STEAM_APPID}..."

if ! ./steamcmd.sh +@sSteamCmdForcePlatformType linux +force_install_dir /mnt/server +login "${STEAM_USER}" "${STEAM_PASS}" ${STEAM_AUTH:-} \
  +app_update "${STEAM_APPID}" $( [[ -z "${BETA_BRANCH:-}" ]] || printf %s "-beta ${BETA_BRANCH}" ) $( [[ -z "${BETA_PASSWORD:-}" ]] || printf %s "-betapassword ${BETA_PASSWORD}" ) ${INSTALL_FLAGS:-} validate +quit; then
  echo ""
  echo "SteamCMD failed. If you saw (Missing configuration): ensure this egg uses +@sSteamCmdForcePlatformType linux (shipped), try Beta Branch = staging, use SteamCMD Login Username+Password with an account that owns s&box, or reinstall after deleting steamcmd under the server install path."
  exit 1
fi

mkdir -p /mnt/server/.steam/sdk32 /mnt/server/.steam/sdk64
cp -v linux32/steamclient.so /mnt/server/.steam/sdk32/steamclient.so 2>/dev/null || true
cp -v linux64/steamclient.so /mnt/server/.steam/sdk64/steamclient.so 2>/dev/null || true

if [[ ! -f "/mnt/server/steamapps/common/sbox dedicated server/sbox-server.dll" ]] && [[ ! -f "/mnt/server/steamapps/common/sbox dedicated server/sbox-server.exe" ]] && [[ ! -f "/mnt/server/sbox-server.dll" ]] && [[ ! -f "/mnt/server/sbox-server.exe" ]]; then
  echo "Install verification failed: sbox-server.dll / sbox-server.exe not found under steamapps path or server root."
  find /mnt/server -maxdepth 5 \( -name "sbox-server.dll" -o -name "sbox-server.exe" \) 2>/dev/null | head -20 || true
  exit 1
fi

echo "Installation completed successfully."
exit 0

variables.name: Game Port
variables.description: Primary game port (+port). Usually matches allocation.

variables.name: Query Port
variables.description: A2S/query (+net_query_port). Must differ from game port when both are bound.

variables.name: Local .sbproj Path
variables.description: Optional path to a .sbproj per Facepunch; passed as extra arg when set. Leave empty if unused.

variables.name: Extra CLI Args
variables.description: Appended verbatim at end of startup (advanced).

variables.name: Beta Branch
variables.description: SteamCMD beta branch; empty = default/public. Facepunch documents `-staging` for dedicated server; try `staging` if install returns Missing configuration or an outdated public depot.

variables.name: Beta Password
variables.description: Password for private beta branch if required.

variables.name: Install Extra Flags
variables.description: Extra tokens passed to SteamCMD during install (space-separated).

variables.name: SteamCMD Login Username
variables.description: Optional. Set together with SteamCMD Login Password to download as your Steam user (e.g. if anonymous fails with No subscription). Leave empty for anonymous.

variables.name: SteamCMD Login Password
variables.description: Optional. Password for SteamCMD account login. Required if SteamCMD Login Username is set.

variables.name: SteamCMD Login Guard Code
variables.description: Optional third argument to +login (e.g. Steam Guard code) when using account login.

variables.name: Max Players
variables.description: Slot target for operators; wire player limits via EXTRA_ARGS if your build uses a ConVar not covered here.
